messages.subject: Label for pairs of correlated errors
parts:
Hello,

I'm in the process of translating an SEM model from MPLUS to Lavaan, and I am having difficulty assigning a label to pairs of correlated errors. I've been able to label individual parameters, but in this instance I'm trying to label the whole correlation. I will need to be able to call these pairs later in my syntax to further constrain my model. The full model is very long so I've posted the relevant chunks from both MPLUS and lavaan below. 

MPLUS syntax: 

!sets frees and labels individual error terms

        i1i2 WITH i1i3*1 (e1);
i1i2 WITH i1i4*1 (e1);
i1i2 WITH i2i3*-1 (e2_n);
i1i2 WITH i2i4*-1 (e2_n);
i1i3 WITH i1i4*1 (e1);
i1i3 WITH i2i3*1 (e3);
i1i3 WITH i3i4*-1 (e3_n);
i1i4 WITH i2i4*1 (e4);
i1i4 WITH i3i4*1 (e4);
i2i3 WITH i2i4*1 (e2);

!correlates and labels the correlated error terms
i1i2*2 (e1e2);
i1i3*2 (e1e3);
i1i4*2 (e1e4);
i2i3*2 (e2e3);
i2i4*2 (e2e4);
i3i4*2 (e3e4);

lavaan syntax:

#set frees and labels individual error terms (this code appears to be working)
            i1i2 ~~ start(2)*i1i2 + e1e2*i1i2
            i1i3 ~~ start(2)*i1i3 + e1e3*i1i3
            i1i4 ~~ start(2)*i1i4 + e1e4*i1i4
            i2i3 ~~ start(2)*i2i3 + e2e3*i2i3
            i2i4 ~~ start(2)*i2i4 + e2e4*i2i4
            i3i4 ~~ start(2)*i3i4 + e3e4*i3i4

#correlated and label the correlated error terms (this is what breaks my model)

            e1*(i1i2 ~~ start(1)*i1i3)
            e1*(i1i2 ~~ start(1)*i1i4) 
            e2_n*(i1i2 ~~ start(-1)*i2i3)
            e2_n*(i1i2 ~~ start(-1)*i2i4) 
            e1*(i1i3 ~~ start(1)*i1i4)
            e3*(i1i3 ~~ start(1)*i2i3)
            e3_n*(i1i3 ~~ start(-1)*i3i4)
            e4*(i1i4 ~~ start(1)*i2i4)
            e4*(i1i4 ~~ start(1)*i3i4)
            e2*(i2i3 ~~ start(1)*i2i4)

Error in parse(text = x, keep.source = FALSE) : 
  <text>:1:56: unexpected symbol
1: ~ start(2)*i11i12+e11e12*i11i12e1*(i1i2~~start(1)*i1i3)e1
                                                                                   ^

Any thoughts on how to input this into R would be appreciated. I'm sure I'm just not specifying the labels correctly, but I can't seem to find a good answer on how to properly specify the labels. 

Thank you!

Rachel

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Label for pairs of correlated errors
parts:
On 06/09/2015 07:40 PM, RTK wrote:
> e1*(i1i2 ~~ start(1)*i1i3)

Without any starting values/labels, we would write

i1i3 ~~ i1i3

Adding a starting value:

i1i3 ~~ start(1)*i1i3

Adding a label:

i1i3 ~~ start(1)*i1i3 + e1*i1i3

All modifiers (things ending with a '*') appear on the right hand side
of the operator (here "~~") only.

Yves.

parts:
Thank you for your response; I think maybe I didn't word my question properly. 

I'm trying to add a label to the correlation between two different variables. I tried running it with just the 2nd variable labeled as you suggested, but the lavaan output is not giving my the same number of df as MPLUS. My understanding of what the MPLUS syntax is doing is that it's labeling the correlation between variable 2 and variable 3 with 1 label for that line of code and later setting constraints among sets of correlations between error terms. 

I'm attempting to label the entire correlation rather than a single parameter

MPLUS:

i1i2 WITH i1i3*1 (e1);
i1i2 WITH i1i4*1 (e1);

On 06/09/2015 07:40 PM, RTK wrote:

Without any starting values/labels, we would write

i1i3 ~~ i1i3

Adding a starting value:

i1i3 ~~ start(1)*i1i3

Adding a label:

i1i3 ~~ start(1)*i1i3 + e1*i1i3

All modifiers (things ending with a '*') appear on the right hand side
of the operator (here "~~") only.

Yves.

> I'm attempting to label the entire correlation rather than a single
> parameter
>
> MPLUS:
>
> i1i2 WITH i1i3*1 (e1);
> i1i2 WITH i1i4*1 (e1);

This would be in lavaan:

i1i2 ~~ start(1)*i1i3 + e1*i1i3
i1i2 ~~ start(1)*i1i4 + e1*i1i4

If this still does not do what you want, you will need to show us the
full input/output of Mplus, and the full script + output of lavaan.

Yves.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Label for pairs of correlated errors
parts:
> Warning message:
> In lav_partable_constraints_ceq(partable, con = LIST, debug = debug) :
> lavaan WARNING: non-free parameter(s) in equality constraint(s): L2_n
> L3_n e1e2 e1e3 e1e4 e2e3 e2e4 e3e4 e5e6 e5e7 e5e8 e6e7 e6e8 e7e8 e9e10
> e9e11 e9e12 e10e11 e10e12 e11e12

This is your problem: in lavaan (0.5-18), you can not use non-free (ie.
fixed to a constant) parameters in equality constraints.

It is rather easy to fix this: just avoid trivial constraints. For
example, instead of saying:

L2_n == -L2

you just fix 'L2' to the value -1 (since L2_n is 1 anyway).

Yves.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Label for pairs of correlated errors
parts:
On 06/11/2015 06:25 PM, RTK wrote:
> Looking at the output from the two programs it appears that there are
> additional constraints on the first factor loading in lavaan on each
> latent variable that are not there in MPLUS. And since the first three
> loadings have an equality constraint the factor loading seems to be
> fixed for the first three loadings on each trait. Is there any way
> around this?

The standard way is to add the option 'std.lv = TRUE'. Or, you can
manually 'free' (and label) the first factor loading by writing

Trait1 =~ NA*i1i2 + L1*1i2 + ...

Yves.
